extensions.title: Root identity at the observation level
extensions.status: exploratory hunch; not a registered hypothesis
extensions.question_and_delta: Does a quorum still work when different sites copy one upstream observation, or one site hosts independent observations? This crosses root-label granularity with correlation rather than merely counting domains.
extensions.comparison: Generate a fixed fact set; cross copied versus independent observations with domain, owner and observation-level groupings. Compare headcount, observable grouping and oracle grouping on false commits and deadline success.
extensions.confounds: Source authority and marginal accuracy must stay fixed; oracle observation IDs cannot enter the deployed arm.
extensions.feasibility: Small deterministic fixture first; inferred provenance later.
extensions.decision_value: Choose the unit a future evidence ledger should count.

extensions.title: Asymmetric errors in provenance
extensions.status: exploratory hunch; not a registered hypothesis

extensions.comparison: Independently sweep false merges and false splits; include a lone correct specialist. Compare grouping policies at matched false rejection and useful coverage.
extensions.confounds: Noise must not reveal which source is correct; source grouping and model competence are separate factors.
extensions.feasibility: Small fixture with known lineage; needs labeled errors for real traces.
extensions.decision_value: Set asymmetric review priorities for a provenance estimator.
